raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions holds 28 rows with record_version=2 that duplicate existing txn_ids (4975 distinct over 5003 rows), and silver_transactions keeps every version. Keeping only the highest record_version per txn_id, then applying the POSTED filter, should yield one current row per transaction; the version-2 rows are assumed to be corrections that supersede version 1, and the data does not confirm this.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY record_version DESC, ingest_ts DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
